python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess as sp
head=open('/work/model.scad').read().split('\n')[:71]
head='\n'.join(head)+'\n'
tests={'if-part': 'if(part=="box"){\ncube(1);\n}\n',
 'if-p2': 'p2="box";\nif(p2=="box"){\ncube(1);\n}\n',
 'if-PART': 'PART="box";\nif(PART=="box"){\ncube(1);\n}\n',
 'echo-only': 'echo(cadverify_spec=[[1,2]]);\ncube(1);\n'}
for k,t in tests.items():
    open('/tmp/tt.scad','w').write(head+t)
    r=sp.run(['openscad','/tmp/tt.scad','-o','/tmp/tt.stl'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    print(k,'||',(r.stdout+r.stderr).split('\n')[0][:120])
EOF
echo "=== is 'part' reserved? ==="
cat > /tmp/kw.scad <<'EOF'
part="box";
cube(1);
EOF
openscad /tmp/kw.scad -o /tmp/kw.stl 2>&1 | head -3
